119: def _set_col_widths(table, ncols):
120:     total_twips = int(CONTENT_WIDTH_CM * 567)
121:     share = total_twips // ncols
122:     widths = [share] * ncols
123:     widths[-1] += total_twips - sum(widths)
124:     # tblGrid
125:     grid = table._tbl.find(qn("w:tblGrid"))
126:     if grid is not None:
127:         for gridcol, w in zip(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol")), widths):
128:             gridcol.set(qn("w:w"), str(w))
129:     for row in table.rows:
130:         for cell, w in zip(row.cells, widths):
131:             cell.width = Pt(w / 20.0)

143: def _parse_row(line):
144:     inner = line.strip()
145:     if inner.startswith("|"):
146:         inner = inner[1:]
147:     if inner.endswith("|"):
148:         inner = inner[:-1]
149:     return [c.strip() for c in inner.split("|")]

152: def _is_separator(line):
153:     cells = _parse_row(line)
154:     return all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{2,}:?", c) for c in cells if c != "") and len(cells) > 0

197: def add_table(doc: Document, rows):
198:     header = rows[0]
199:     body = rows[1:]
200:     ncols = len(header)
201:     table = doc.add_table(rows=1 + len(body), cols=ncols)
202:     table.style = "Table Grid"
203:     table.autofit = False
204:     _set_fixed_layout(table)
205: 
206:     for j, text in enumerate(header):
207:         _cell_text(table.rows[0].cells[j], text, TABLE_SIZE_PT, bold=True)
208:         _shade(table.rows[0].cells[j]._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(), "D9E2F3")
209:     _set_repeat_header(table.rows[0])
210:     _set_cant_split(table.rows[0])
211: 
212:     for i, r in enumerate(body, start=1):
213:         for j in range(ncols):
214:             value = r[j] if j < len(r) else ""
215:             _cell_text(table.rows[i].cells[j], value, TABLE_SIZE_PT)
216:         _set_cant_split(table.rows[i])
217: 
218:     _set_col_widths(table, ncols)
219:     return table

222: def build(md_text: str) -> Document:
223:     doc = Document()
224:     configure_document(doc)
225: 
226:     lines = md_text.splitlines()
227:     i = 0
228:     total_tables = 0
229:     while i < len(lines):
230:         line = lines[i]
231:         stripped = line.strip()
232: 
233:         if stripped == "[[PAGEBREAK]]":
234:             p = doc.add_paragraph()
235:             p.add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)
236:             i += 1
237:             continue
238: 
239:         if stripped == "":
240:             i += 1
241:             continue
242: 
243:         if stripped.startswith("|"):
244:             block = []
245:             while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip().startswith("|"):
246:                 block.append(lines[i])
247:                 i += 1
248:             rows = []
249:             for b in block:
250:                 if _is_separator(b):
251:                     continue
252:                 rows.append(_parse_row(b))
253:             if rows:
254:                 add_table(doc, rows)
255:                 total_tables += 1
256:             continue
257: 
258:         if stripped.startswith("### "):
259:             h = doc.add_heading(level=3)
260:             _add_inline(h, stripped[4:], 12.0, base_bold=True)
261:             i += 1
262:             continue
263: 
264:         if stripped.startswith("## "):
265:             h = doc.add_heading(level=2)
266:             _add_inline(h, stripped[3:], 14.0, base_bold=True)
267:             i += 1
268:             continue
269: 
270:         if stripped.startswith("# "):
271:             h = doc.add_heading(level=1)
272:             _add_inline(h, stripped[2:], 18.0, base_bold=True)
273:             i += 1
274:             continue
275: 
276:         if stripped.startswith("> "):
277:             p = doc.add_paragraph()
278:             p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Cm(0.4)
279:             p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(3)
280:             p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
281:             _shade(p._p.get_or_add_pPr(), "FFF2CC")
282:             _add_inline(p, stripped[2:], BODY_SIZE_PT, base_bold=True)
283:             i += 1
284:             continue
285: 
286:         if stripped.startswith("- "):
287:             p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet")
288:             _add_inline(p, stripped[2:], BODY_SIZE_PT)
289:             i += 1
290:             continue
291: 
292:         p = doc.add_paragraph()
293:         _add_inline(p, stripped, BODY_SIZE_PT)
294:         i += 1
295: 
296:     return doc

300: def collect_font_sizes(doc: Document):
301:     body_sizes, table_sizes = [], []
302: 
303:     def run_size(run, default):
304:         if run.font.size is not None:
305:             return run.font.size.pt
306:         style = run.style
307:         while style is not None:
308:             if style.font.size is not None:
309:                 return style.font.size.pt
310:             style = style.base_style
311:         return default
312: 
313:     for p in doc.paragraphs:
314:         for run in p.runs:
315:             if run.text.strip():
316:                 body_sizes.append(run_size(run, BODY_SIZE_PT))
317: 
318:     for table in doc.tables:
319:         for row in table.rows:
320:             for cell in row.cells:
321:                 for p in cell.paragraphs:
322:                     for run in p.runs:
323:                         if run.text.strip():
324:                             table_sizes.append(run_size(run, TABLE_SIZE_PT))
325: 
326:     return body_sizes, table_sizes
